derived_from: Persona Continuity Risk Engine structural method, adapted to football evidence rather than personality inference
purpose: Measure what remains structurally stable, what has materially changed, and whether a current match inference is genuinely supported by continuity or contradicted by a recent delta.

vectors.name: Structural Baseline
vectors.football_translation: Season W-L, points for/against, point differential and scoring rates establish the team's persistent performance frame.
vectors.rule: Baseline is descriptive evidence, not a prediction by itself.

vectors.name: Recent Performance Delta
vectors.football_translation: Compare recent scoring differential with the season baseline to detect genuine change in current output.
vectors.rule: Keep raw season and recent values visible. Never compress a material delta into a generic form label.

vectors.name: Role and Personnel Continuity
vectors.football_translation: Track named roles, availability, returns, withdrawals, combinations and replacement effects against the prior team state.
vectors.rule: No news is NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE only when roster coverage is actually complete.

vectors.name: Adaptability Under Pressure
vectors.football_translation: Observe how verified role or tactical changes perform under injury, rotation, weather, finals pressure or opponent-specific disruption.
vectors.rule: Adaptability requires repeated outcome evidence. A single successful change is not a stable trait.

vectors.name: Decision Continuity
vectors.football_translation: Test whether the frozen MAYHEM selection remains consistent with the latest verified evidence or survives only because the original narrative is being defended.
vectors.rule: A material evidence delta must be acknowledged before continuity of selection can be claimed.

vectors.name: Outcome Continuity
vectors.football_translation: Post-match, test whether the observed outcome reinforces, contradicts or leaves unresolved the pre-match structural model.
vectors.rule: Outcome alone cannot validate a causal mechanism; audit the evidence path.

delta_engine.season_metric: season point differential per completed match
delta_engine.recent_metric: last-five point differential per completed match
delta_engine.direction: UP if delta > 0; DOWN if delta < 0; FLAT if delta = 0
delta_engine.integrity: Thresholds are transparent operational bands, not claims of statistical significance.

containment_matrix.containment: Keep season baseline, recent delta, roster, player statistics, weather, matchup and market as separate evidence families.
If current evidence materially contradicts the frozen preference before T-10m, explicitly record the discontinuity and re-run gates rather than defending continuity.
Do not let a short recent run erase the season structural baseline without evidence that the underlying mechanism changed.
Club history, ladder reputation and prior finals success cannot substitute for current roster and performance evidence.
Debutants and short NRL samples remain uncertainty unless directional evidence exists.
When personnel, role, weather, matchup or market conditions change materially, show the delta explicitly before saying the original football rationale remains intact.

public_surface_rule: Expose useful baseline, delta, role-continuity and falsification information. Keep internal weighting mechanics and calibration eligibility out of ordinary tipping presentation.
learning_rule: Only audited post-match evidence may convert an observed continuity pattern into a learned future weight.
